elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance duration up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Confidential Information and other Company data and materials

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (iii) thereafter delete such Company data and materials from its systems
certify such deletion to Company in writing
for up to six (6) months (exceeds and therefore encompasses 90 days)
within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Confidential Information and other Company data

reasons: The inserted subsection (d) supplies every preferred atomic element: 6-month transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion with written certification.

The 'at Company's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance; the 30-day return, deletion and certification duties remain mandatory and run from expiry or termination rather than from any later request.

Insertion is a single concise new subsection addressing an absent clause; no untouched sentence is altered, no defined term is left dangling, and no other commercial term (termination notice periods, final fee payment, Works assignment) is affected.
Minor drafting note only: 'reasonable' qualifies the assistance obligation, which is customary and does not undercut the preferred position.
